text: As this report proposes to dedicate as a public highway a 0.3 metre wide strip of land along the frontage of 158 Borough Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services recommends that the reserve strip of land on the north side of Borough Drive, between Town Centre Court and Borough Approach East, be designated as a public Highway.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council dedicate as a public highway the 0.3 metre wide strip of land on the north side of Borough Drive, between Town Centre Court and Borough Approach East, as illustrated on Plan 66R-21521 set out in Attachment 1 to the report (June 14, 2022) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services. 2. City Council authorize and direct the appropriate City Officials to take the necessary action to give effect to City Council's decision, including the introduction in Council of any and all Bills that may be required.
